steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil in a large pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic and cook a few minutes until the onion softens.
Pour in the pasta sauce, add a splash of pasta water, and simmer about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Bake the garlic toast following the box directions while the sauce simmers.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce and serve with the toast and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Turkey Spaghetti with Meat Sauce

steps: Cook the onion in the oil for a few minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned all the way through, breaking it into small crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a splash of water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill each tortilla with turkey, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey Tacos

steps: Melt half the butter in a big skillet and cook the potato cubes over medium heat, stirring now and then, until they are golden and almost tender, about 15 minutes. Set them aside.
In the same pan, cook the pork cubes until browned on the outside and cooked through. Set aside with the potatoes.
Add the rest of the butter and the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for a minute, then slowly stir in the milk to make a simple sauce. Let it bubble until it thickens a little.
Put the pork and potatoes back in the pan, add the garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir everything together so the sauce coats it all. Cook 2 more minutes.
Cook the green beans following the bag directions and serve on the side.
recipes.title: Cubed Pork and Potato Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and green beans until the beans are tender and a little browned at the edges.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then put the pork back in.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir everything together for a minute. Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Pork and Green Bean Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Stir in the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked rice, soy sauce, and garlic powder. Stir everything together and cook 2 more minutes so the flavors mix.
recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Skillet

ingredients.note: cooked and cooled, day-old works best

steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a big skillet or wok, then set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the onion and the frozen peas and carrots until tender.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry a few minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir so the rice colors evenly.
Fold the eggs back in, cook one more minute, and serve.
recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice

steps: Heat the soup and milk together in a pot, stirring now and then, until hot. Do not boil it hard.
Butter the outside of the bread slices and build sandwiches with 2 slices of cheese each.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium heat until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve with the soup for dipping.
recipes.title: Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pot for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the tomato soup plus a can of water and stir well.
Simmer gently about 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until a little thicker. Taste and add salt if it needs it.
Serve in bowls topped with cheddar and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey Chili

ingredients.note: broken in half so it fits the dish

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the spaghetti until just tender and drain it.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil in a big pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the pasta sauce, milk, and garlic powder and let it simmer 5 minutes.
Mix the spaghetti through the sauce, then spread it in a baking dish.
Cover the top with the shredded cheddar and bake about 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
recipes.title: Cheesy Turkey Pasta Bake

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken strips in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the frozen vegetables until tender and any water has cooked off.
Put the chicken back in, add the soy sauce and garlic powder, and stir for a minute.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Chicken Stir Fry with Frozen Vegetables

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and the frozen peas and carrots until tender.
Put the pork back in, add the soy sauce and garlic powder, and stir for a minute.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Pork Stir Fry with Peas and Carrots

ingredients.note: part for the meatloaf, part for the potatoes
spread on top as a glaze

steps: Heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix the ground turkey, egg, bread crumbs, half the milk, onion, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl with your hands until just combined.
Shape the mix into a loaf in a baking dish and spread the pasta sauce over the top.
Bake about 45 minutes, until the middle is cooked through and no longer pink.
While it bakes, boil the potatoes until tender, then mash them with the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the green beans following the bag directions and serve everything together.
recipes.title: Turkey Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Toss the potato wedges with half the oil, half the paprika, and a pinch of salt, spread them on a baking sheet, and bake about 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Mix the ground turkey with the garlic powder, the rest of the paprika, salt, and pepper, and shape it into 4 patties a little wider than the buns.
Cook the patties in the rest of the oil in a big skillet over medium heat, about 6 minutes per side, until cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Lay a slice of cheese on each patty for the last minute so it melts.
Serve the patties on the buns with lettuce and tomato, and the oven fries on the side.
recipes.title: Turkey Burgers with Oven Fries

steps: Boil the rotini in salted water until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Cook the onion in the oil in a big pan for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the diced tomatoes with their juice and simmer about 8 minutes, until a little thicker.
Stir the rotini through the chili, adding a splash of pasta water if it looks dry. Serve with cheddar on top.
recipes.title: Turkey Chili Rotini

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pot for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes with their juice, both cans of beans, and a cup of water. Stir well.
Simmer gently about 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chili thickens a little. Taste and add salt if it needs it.
Serve in bowls topped with cheddar and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey and Two-Bean Chili

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash with the butter, milk, and half the salt.
While the potatoes cook, heat the oven to 400 degrees and cook the onion in the oil in a big skillet until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. Stir in the garlic powder, the rest of the salt, and the pepper.
Stir the peas and carrots into the turkey and cook 2 minutes, then spread the mix in a baking dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the top, sprinkle with cheddar, and bake about 15 minutes, until the top is golden in spots.
recipes.title: Turkey Shepherd's Pie

steps: Mix the ground turkey, egg, bread crumbs, garlic, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl with your hands until just combined. Roll into balls about the size of a golf ball.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a big skillet, turning them so they color on all sides, about 8 minutes. They do not need to be cooked through yet.
Pour the pasta sauce over the meatballs, cover, and simmer gently about 12 minutes, until the meatballs are cooked through.
While they simmer, boil the spaghetti in salted water until just tender and drain it.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti.
recipes.title: Turkey Meatballs with Spaghetti

steps: Toss the chicken strips with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt.
Cook the chicken in the oil in a big skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion until soft with browned edges, about 8 minutes.
Put the chicken back in and stir everything together for a minute.
Warm the tortillas and serve the chicken and vegetables in them with cheese and sour cream.
recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas

steps: Cook the chicken pieces in half the oil in a big skillet until cooked through. Stir in the chili powder and garlic powder, then set the chicken aside.
Cook the diced pepper in the same pan for a few minutes until it softens a little.
Lay out 4 tortillas and divide the chicken, pepper, and cheese over them. Top with the other 4 tortillas.
Cook each quesadilla in the rest of the oil over medium heat until the outside is crisp and golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft, then add the broccoli and cook until tender.
Stir in the cooked rice, milk, garlic powder, and salt.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover the pan, and let it sit off the heat for 2 minutes until the cheese melts. Stir it through and serve.
recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken and Broccoli Rice

steps: Boil the egg noodles until just tender and drain them.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the onion a few minutes until soft. Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Slowly stir in the milk and let it bubble until it thickens into a simple sauce. Stir in the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Add the noodles and chicken back in with the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and cook 2 more minutes.
recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Skillet

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pan for a few minutes until soft.
Add the chicken breasts, the tomato soup, and a soup can of water. Cover and simmer gently about 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Take the chicken out and shred it with two forks.
Stir the chili powder and garlic powder into the sauce and simmer a few minutes until it thickens a little.
Put the chicken back in the sauce and stir it through. Spoon it onto the buns and serve the salad on the side.
recipes.title: Sloppy Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.note: cooked and cooled, day-old works best

steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a big skillet or wok, then set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the pork cubes until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and the frozen peas and carrots and cook until tender.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry a few minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir so the rice colors evenly. Fold the eggs back in, cook one more minute, and serve.
recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees.
Toss the potato wedges with half the oil, half the garlic powder and paprika, and a pinch of salt. Spread them on a big baking sheet and roast 15 minutes.
Toss the pork cubes, onion wedges, and green beans with the rest of the oil and spices.
Add the pork and vegetables to the sheet with the potatoes and spread everything into one layer.
Roast about 15 minutes more, until the pork is cooked through and the potatoes are crisp at the edges.
recipes.title: Sheet Pan Pork and Potatoes

steps: Toss the pork strips with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt.
Cook the pork in the oil in a big skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion until soft with browned edges, about 8 minutes.
Put the pork back in and stir everything together for a minute.
Warm the tortillas and serve the pork and vegetables in them with cheese and sour cream.
recipes.title: Pork Fajitas

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until soft.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on the outside.
Stir in the pasta sauce, chili powder, and garlic powder. Cover and simmer gently about 10 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and the sauce thickens a little.
Spoon the pork and sauce onto the buns and serve the salad on the side.
recipes.title: Saucy Pork Sandwiches

steps: Boil the rotini in salted water until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Stir in the rotini, milk, and garlic powder, adding a splash of pasta water to make a light sauce.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover, and let it sit off the heat 2 minutes until melted. Stir through and serve.
recipes.title: Cheesy Pork Rotini Skillet

steps: Cook the potato cubes in the oil in a big skillet over medium heat, stirring now and then, until golden and tender, about 15 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper and cook a few minutes until soft. Stir in the paprika, salt, and pepper.
Beat the eggs in a bowl and pour them evenly over the potatoes.
Cover and cook on low about 5 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover for 1 more minute to melt it, and serve straight from the pan.
recipes.title: Potato and Egg Breakfast Skillet

steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until soft.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper and pour them into the pan. Stir gently as they cook until they are scrambled and just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or in the microwave under a damp towel.
Divide the eggs over the tortillas, sprinkle with cheddar, and roll them up burrito style.
Serve with sour cream on the side.
recipes.title: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Burritos

steps: Heat the oven to 400 degrees.
Cook the onion and frozen vegetables in the oil in an oven-safe skillet until the vegetables are tender and any water has cooked off.
Beat the eggs with the milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
Cook on the stove on low for about 3 minutes, until the edges start to set, then sprinkle the cheddar on top.
Move the skillet to the oven and bake about 10 minutes, until the middle is set. Let it rest 5 minutes, then slice it like a pie.
recipes.title: Veggie Frittata

steps: Cook the potato cubes in the oil in a big skillet over medium heat, stirring now and then, until golden and tender, about 15 minutes. Add the onion, paprika, salt, and pepper for the last 5 minutes. Set aside and keep warm.
Beat 2 eggs at a time in a small bowl.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat, pour in the eggs, and let them set, tilting the pan so the runny egg reaches the edges.
Lay a slice of cheese on one half, fold the omelet over, and slide it onto a plate. Repeat for the other 3 omelets.
Serve the omelets with the home fries.
recipes.title: Cheese Omelets with Home Fries

steps: Boil the rotini in salted water until just tender and drain it.
In the same pot, melt the butter and stir in the flour. Cook 1 minute, stirring all the time.
Slowly stir in the milk and let it bubble gently until it thickens into a smooth sauce.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until it melts. Stir in the garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Stir the rotini back through the sauce and serve right away.
recipes.title: Stovetop Rotini Mac and Cheese

steps: Cook the diced pepper in half the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until it softens a little. Set aside.
Lay out 4 tortillas and divide the cheese and pepper over them. Top with the other 4 tortillas.
Cook each quesadilla in the rest of the oil over medium heat until the outside is crisp and golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Cheese Quesadillas

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the rotini until just tender and drain it.
Stir the frozen vegetables into the hot pasta and let them thaw in the heat for a minute.
Mix the pasta and vegetables with the pasta sauce, milk, and garlic powder, then spread it all in a baking dish.
Cover the top with the shredded cheddar and bake about 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling at the edges.
recipes.title: Veggie Pasta Bake

steps: Melt the butter in a big skillet and cook the potato cubes over medium heat, stirring now and then, until golden and almost tender, about 15 minutes.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Stir in the peas and carrots, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and cook until heated through.
Pour in the milk, sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover, and cook on low about 3 minutes until the cheese melts into the potatoes.
recipes.title: Cheesy Potato and Pea Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions if it is not already cooked, and keep it warm.
Cook the onion in the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until soft.
Add the beans, chili powder, and cumin with a splash of water. Mash some of the beans with the back of a spoon and simmer about 5 minutes until thick.
Warm the tortillas, then divide the rice, beans, and cheese over them and roll them up burrito style.
Serve with sour cream on the side.
recipes.title: Bean and Cheese Burritos

steps: Heat the oven to 325 degrees. Pat the roast dry and season it all over with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat and brown the roast on all sides, about 8 minutes total. Set it on a plate.
Add the onions to the pot and cook a few minutes, scraping up the browned bits. Stir in the garlic.
Pour in the broth, return the roast to the pot, cover, and put it in the oven for about 2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots around the roast, cover again, and cook about 1 hour more, until the meat pulls apart with a fork.
Slice or shred the roast and serve it with the vegetables and the cooking liquid spooned over.
recipes.title: Beef Pot Roast with Carrots and Potatoes

steps: Toss the beef cubes with the salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches; set it aside.
Cook the onion in the same pot until it softens, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the broth and tomatoes, scraping up the browned bits, and return the beef to the pot. Simmer gently, covered, for about 1 hour.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer about 30 minutes more, until the beef and vegetables are tender.
Stir the flour into a splash of cold water, stir it into the stew, and simmer 5 minutes to thicken. Stir in the peas and carrots and heat through.
Rest 10 minutes off the heat and serve in bowls.
recipes.title: Hearty Beef Stew

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the ground beef, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Spoon off the extra fat.
Add the onion and cook until it softens, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt and cook 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice and both cans of beans. Simmer about 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until slightly thickened.
Serve with the cheddar and sour cream on top.
recipes.title: Beef and Bean Chili

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the ground beef, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Spoon off the extra fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a splash of water. Simmer 3 minutes until the meat is coated and saucy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill the tortillas with the beef and let everyone add cheddar, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Serve with the salsa and tortilla chips on the side.
recipes.title: Beef Tacos

steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and carrots until soft, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and brown it, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Spoon off the extra fat.
Pour in the pasta sauce and milk, season with salt and pepper, and simmer about 12 minutes, adding a splash of pasta water if it gets thick.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce and serve with the parmesan at the table.
recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Toss the fries with the oil and half the salt on a sheet pan and bake about 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Mix the beef with the garlic powder, the rest of the salt, and the pepper. Form four patties a little wider than the buns, with a dent in the middle of each.
Cook the patties in a hot pan or on a grill about 4 minutes per side, until cooked through. Lay the cheese on top for the last minute.
Toast the buns cut side down in the pan for a minute.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, and onion, and serve with the oven fries.
recipes.title: Beef Burgers with Oven Fries

steps: Boil salted water and cook the egg noodles until tender. Drain and set aside.
Season the beef strips with salt and pepper. Melt the butter in a large pan over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches; set it aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the same pan until the mushrooms give up their liquid and start to brown, about 7 minutes.
Sprinkle in the flour and garlic powder and stir 1 minute. Pour in the broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits, until it thickens a little.
Return the beef and simmer about 8 minutes, until tender. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the sour cream.
Serve the stroganoff spooned over the egg noodles.
recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff with Egg Noodles

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the lasagna noodles until just tender, drain, and lay them flat so they do not stick.
Brown the ground beef in the oil, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic, spoon off the fat, and stir in the pasta sauce. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir the cream cheese, the egg, half the parmesan, and the salt together in a bowl.
Layer a third of the sauce in a 9 by 13 inch dish, then noodles, then half the cheese mixture and a third of the mozzarella. Repeat, finishing with sauce and the rest of the mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake about 15 minutes more, until bubbling and browned in spots.
Rest 10 minutes before cutting so the slices hold together.
recipes.title: Beef Lasagna

steps: Mix the beef with the breadcrumbs, egg, milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Roll into balls about the size of a golf ball.
Melt the butter in a large pan and brown the meatballs on all sides, about 8 minutes. They will finish cooking in the gravy. Set them aside.
Stir the flour into the pan drippings and cook 1 minute. Pour in the broth a little at a time, stirring, and simmer until it thickens into a gravy.
Return the meatballs to the pan, cover, and simmer about 10 minutes, until cooked through. Stir in the cream.
Meanwhile boil salted water and cook the egg noodles until tender. Drain.
Serve the meatballs and gravy over the noodles.
recipes.title: Meatballs with Noodles and Gravy

steps: Toss the beef strips with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the beef in batches until browned, about 5 minutes. Set it aside.
Cook the peppers and onion in the same pan until they soften and char at the edges, about 6 minutes.
Return the beef and any juices to the pan and toss everything together for a minute.
Warm the tortillas and serve the filling with sour cream and cheddar for building fajitas at the table.
recipes.title: Beef Fajitas

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Brown the ground beef in the oil in a large pan, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Spoon off the extra fat.
Add the onion and carrots and cook about 4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cabbage, tomatoes with their juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cover and cook about 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the cabbage is tender.
Serve the beef and cabbage over the rice.
recipes.title: Beef and Cabbage Skillet

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and brown it, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Spoon off the extra fat.
Stir in the barbecue sauce, garlic powder, salt, and a splash of water. Simmer about 8 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Toast the buns, spoon the beef over them, and top with cheddar.
recipes.title: Beef Sloppy Joes

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Stir the soy sauce, honey, garlic powder, flour, and a half cup of water together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the beef strips in batches until browned, about 4 minutes. Set them aside.
Add the broccoli to the pan with a splash of water, cover, and steam about 4 minutes, until bright green and tender-crisp.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce, and stir about 2 minutes, until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry

steps: Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Drain.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Coat each piece in flour, then the beaten egg, then the breadcrumbs mixed with half the parmesan.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken about 4 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Spoon pasta sauce over each piece, top with mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan, cover, and cook 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Serve the chicken over the spaghetti with the extra sauce.
recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan

steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the penne until just tender, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile melt the butter in a large pan and cook the chicken strips until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Set them aside.
Add the garlic to the pan and cook 30 seconds. Pour in the cream and simmer gently about 3 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the parmesan until melted. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss the penne and broccoli through the sauce with a splash of pasta water, top with the chicken, and serve.
recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo Penne

steps: Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender, adding the peas and carrots for the last 2 minutes. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, garlic powder, and a half cup of the hot pasta water together into a sauce.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken strips until cooked through, about 6 minutes. Add the cabbage and cook 2 minutes, until it wilts.
Add the spaghetti and vegetables to the pan, pour in the peanut sauce, and toss until everything is coated, adding more pasta water if it is thick.
Serve right away while the sauce is glossy.
recipes.title: Chicken Peanut Noodles

ingredients.note: split between the filling and the biscuits
split between the filling and the biscuits

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Melt the butter in a large oven-safe pan and cook the chicken pieces until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Set them aside.
Cook the onion and carrots in the same pan until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons of the flour and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and 4 ounces of the milk, stirring, and simmer until thick. Add the mixed vegetables and the chicken and season with half the salt and the pepper.
Stir the rest of the flour with the rest of the salt and the remaining milk into a shaggy biscuit dough. Drop spoonfuls over the filling.
Bake about 15 minutes, until the biscuits are golden and cooked through and the filling is bubbling.
recipes.title: Chicken and Drop-Biscuit Skillet

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Toss the potato wedges with the oil, paprika, half the salt, and the pepper on a sheet pan and bake about 35 minutes, turning once.
Season the chicken with the garlic powder and the rest of the salt. Put it on a second pan or in a baking dish.
Bake the chicken about 20 minutes. Brush it thickly with barbecue sauce and bake about 8 minutes more, until cooked through and the sauce is sticky.
Heat the corn following the package directions.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, slice it, and serve with the wedges and corn.
recipes.title: Oven BBQ Chicken with Potato Wedges

steps: Season the chicken strips with the paprika, garlic powder, and salt. Heat the oil in a large pan and cook them until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Stir the sour cream with a pinch of the paprika and garlic powder for a quick seasoned sauce.
Warm the tortillas so they bend without cracking.
Spread the sauce down the middle of each tortilla and add chicken, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly, and serve.
recipes.title: Chicken and Cheese Wraps

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Stir the soy sauce, honey, garlic powder, flour, and a half cup of water together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken pieces until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Set them aside.
Add the broccoli and carrots to the pan with a splash of water, cover, and steam about 4 minutes.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and stir about 2 minutes, until it thickens and turns glossy.
Serve the chicken and vegetables over the rice with the extra sauce spooned on top.
recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki Bowls

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and carrots until they start to soften, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and add the potatoes. Simmer about 10 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces and simmer about 8 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the egg noodles and corn and cook about 6 minutes, until the noodles are tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls.
recipes.title: Chicken Vegetable Soup

steps: Season the chicken with salt and garlic powder. Coat each piece in the beaten egg, then the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken about 4 minutes per side, until crisp, golden, and cooked through.
Stir the chili powder into the melted butter and brush it over the hot chicken.
Toast the buns and build the sandwiches with lettuce and tomato.
recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Sandwiches

steps: Stir the sour cream with the lemon juice, half the garlic powder, and a pinch of salt. Set the sauce aside.
Toss the chicken strips with the cumin, paprika, the rest of the garlic powder, and the salt.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Warm the tortillas. Spread sauce down the middle of each and add chicken, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Fold in the sides, roll up, and serve with extra sauce.
recipes.title: Chicken Gyro Wraps

ingredients.note: one juiced, one cut into wedges

steps: Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper and coat it lightly in the flour.
Melt half the butter in a large pan and cook the chicken about 4 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through. Set it aside.
Add the garlic to the pan and cook 30 seconds. Pour in the broth and lemon juice, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer 2 minutes. Swirl in the rest of the butter.
Return the chicken to the pan and spoon the sauce over it. Serve over the spaghetti with lemon wedges and parmesan.
recipes.title: Lemon Butter Chicken with Spaghetti

steps: Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Mix the turkey with the breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic powder, and salt. Roll into balls about the size of a golf ball.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a large pan, turning them, about 6 minutes.
Pour in the pasta sauce, cover, and simmer about 10 minutes, until the meatballs are cooked through.
Split the buns, fill each with meatballs and sauce, and top with mozzarella.
Bake about 5 minutes, until the cheese melts and the buns are toasty at the edges.
recipes.title: Turkey Meatball Subs

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Drain.
Melt the butter in a large pan and brown the ground turkey, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Set it aside.
Cook the mushrooms in the same pan until they brown, about 6 minutes. Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and cream, stirring, and simmer until the sauce thickens. Stir in half the parmesan, the peas and carrots, and the turkey. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce, spread it in a baking dish, and top with the rest of the parmesan.
Bake about 15 minutes, until bubbling and golden on top.
recipes.title: Turkey Tetrazzini

ingredients.note: tops cut off and seeds removed

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Cook the rice following the package directions.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Add the onion and cook until soft.
Stir in the cooked rice, tomatoes with their juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and half the cheddar. Cook 2 minutes.
Stand the peppers in a baking dish and fill them with the turkey mixture. Add a splash of water to the dish and cover with foil.
Bake about 30 minutes, until the peppers are tender. Uncover, top with the rest of the cheddar, and bake 5 minutes more.
recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the sweet potatoes about 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until they start to soften and brown at the edges. Add a splash of water and cover for 3 minutes if they need help softening.
Push the sweet potatoes to the side and brown the ground turkey in the same pan, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until soft, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the black beans, corn, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Cook about 5 minutes, until everything is hot and the sweet potatoes are tender.
Scatter the cheddar over the top, cover for a minute to melt it, and serve.
recipes.title: Turkey and Sweet Potato Skillet

steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the penne until just tender. Drain.
Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the sausage, about 7 minutes. Set it aside.
Cook the peppers and onion in the same pan until soft and charred at the edges, about 7 minutes.
Return the sausage, pour in the pasta sauce and garlic powder, and simmer about 5 minutes.
Toss the penne through the sauce and serve with parmesan.
recipes.title: Italian Sausage and Peppers with Penne

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the sausage, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add the onion and carrots and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cumin and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and tomatoes and stir in the lentils. Simmer about 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach and cook 2 minutes, until it wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls.
recipes.title: Sausage and Lentil Soup

ingredients.note: split between the coating and the gravy

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash with the milk and half the butter. Keep warm.
Season the pork medallions with salt, pepper, and garlic powder and coat them lightly with half the flour.
Heat the oil in a large pan and sear the medallions about 3 minutes per side, until browned and just cooked through. Set them aside.
Melt the rest of the butter in the pan and cook the onions slowly until soft and golden, about 10 minutes. Stir in the rest of the flour and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, stirring, and simmer until it thickens into a gravy. Return the pork and simmer 2 minutes.
Serve the pork and onion gravy over the mashed potatoes.
recipes.title: Smothered Pork Medallions with Mashed Potatoes

steps: Heat the oven to 325 degrees. Rub the pork with the paprika, garlic powder, and salt and put it in an oven-safe pot with the broth. Cover and cook about 2 hours, until it shreds easily.
Stir the sour cream, honey, and lemon juice together and toss with the cabbage for a quick slaw. Chill while the pork cooks.
Shred the pork with two forks, discarding any large pieces of fat, and stir in the barbecue sauce. Warm it through on the stove.
Toast the buns and pile on the pork and slaw.
recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the hash browns, pressing them down, about 10 minutes, until crisp and golden on the bottom. Flip in sections and crisp the other side.
Push the potatoes to the edges and brown the sausage in the middle, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Add the pepper and onion and cook until soft.
Stir everything together and spread it flat. Pour the beaten eggs evenly over the top.
Cover and cook on low about 5 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Scatter the cheddar over the top, cover for a minute to melt, season with salt and pepper, and serve from the pan.
recipes.title: Sausage, Egg and Hash Brown Skillet

ingredients.note: split between the biscuits and the gravy
split between the biscuits and the gravy
for serving, cooked how you like

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Stir 1 1/4 cups of the flour with half the salt and the butter, cut in, then stir in about 6 ounces of the milk to a shaggy dough. Drop 8 spoonfuls onto a baking sheet.
Bake the biscuits about 12 minutes, until golden.
Meanwhile brown the sausage in a large pan, breaking it up, about 6 minutes. Do not drain it.

Sprinkle the rest of the flour over the sausage and stir 1 minute. Pour in the rest of the milk a little at a time, stirring, and simmer until it thickens into a gravy. Season with the rest of the salt and the pepper.
Split the warm biscuits, spoon the gravy over them, and serve with the eggs.
recipes.title: Sausage Gravy with Drop Biscuits

steps: Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Drain.
Stir the soy sauce, honey, and garlic powder together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the pork strips until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Set them aside.
Cook the cabbage, carrots, and peas and carrots in the same pan about 4 minutes, until tender-crisp.
Add the spaghetti and pork back to the pan, pour in the sauce, and toss about 2 minutes, until everything is coated and hot.
recipes.title: Pork Lo Mein

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Toss the fries with the oil and salt on a sheet pan and bake about 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Cook the bacon in a large pan until crisp, about 8 minutes. Drain it on paper towels.
Butter the bread and toast it in the bacon pan or a clean pan until golden.
Build the sandwiches with bacon, lettuce, and tomato and a grind of pepper.
Serve with the oven fries.
recipes.title: BLT Sandwiches with Oven Fries

steps: Season the pork medallions with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large pan and sear them about 3 minutes per side, until browned and just cooked through. Set them aside.
Add the green beans to the pan with a splash of water, cover, and steam about 4 minutes, until tender-crisp. Set them with the pork.
Melt the butter in the pan and stir in the honey, soy sauce, and garlic powder. Simmer about 1 minute, until it thickens slightly.
Return the pork and green beans to the pan and toss in the glaze for a minute.
Serve with the extra glaze spooned over.
recipes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Medallions with Green Beans

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the sausage, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until soft, about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and chili powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and add the potatoes. Simmer about 15 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the cream and spinach and cook 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls.
recipes.title: Sausage and Potato Soup

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Pat the salmon dry and season it with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add the salmon skin side down if it has skin and cook about 5 minutes. Flip and cook about 2 minutes more, until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile cook the green beans following the package directions.
Serve the salmon over the rice with the green beans and lemon wedges, spooning the garlic butter over the top.
recipes.title: Garlic Butter Salmon with Rice

steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the shrimp about 2 minutes, until they just turn pink. Set them aside.
Add the garlic and chili powder to the pan and cook 30 seconds. Pour in the lemon juice and a half cup of pasta water and simmer 1 minute.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts. Return the shrimp and add the spaghetti, tossing until everything is coated in the sauce.
Serve with parmesan at the table.
recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi with Spaghetti

steps: Stir the sour cream with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt for a quick sauce. Toss half of it with the cabbage for a slaw and keep the rest for serving.
Toss the shrimp with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp about 3 minutes, until pink and just cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill the tortillas with shrimp and slaw, top with tomato, and serve with the extra sauce.
recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Toss the fries with the oil and half the salt on a sheet pan and bake about 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Stir the breadcrumbs with the paprika, garlic powder, the rest of the salt, and the pepper.
Pat the cod dry. Coat each piece in the beaten egg, then press it into the breadcrumbs.
Put the cod on a second oiled pan and bake about 12 minutes, until the coating is crisp and the fish flakes easily.
Stir the sour cream with the lemon juice for a quick sauce and serve the fish with the fries, lemon wedges, and sauce.
recipes.title: Crispy Baked Cod with Oven Fries

steps: Stir the tuna with the sour cream, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, breaking it up with a fork.
Butter one side of each bread slice. Build four sandwiches with the tuna and a cheese slice, buttered sides out.
Cook the sandwiches in a large pan over medium heat about 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Serve with the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Tuna Melts with Garden Salad

steps: Boil salted water and cook the egg noodles until just tender, adding the peas and carrots for the last 2 minutes. Drain.
Melt the butter in a large pan, stir in the flour, and cook 1 minute. Pour in the milk a little at a time, stirring, and simmer until it thickens.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the cheddar until melted. Season with salt and pepper.
Fold in the noodles, vegetables, and tuna and warm through.
Scatter the breadcrumbs over the top and run the pan under a hot broiler for about 2 minutes, until golden. If the pan is not broiler safe, cover it for a minute instead and skip the crisp top.
recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and spread it on a plate to cool a little. Cold or room temperature rice fries best.
Heat half the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp about 2 minutes, until pink. Set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil and the peas and carrots and cook about 3 minutes.
Push the vegetables to the side, pour in the eggs, and scramble them until just set.
Add the rice, shrimp, soy sauce, garlic powder, and salt. Stir fry about 3 minutes, until the rice is hot and a little crisp at the edges.
recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.note: about 1 cup, split between the cakes and the coating
one for the cakes, one for the coating

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 12 minutes. Add the cod on top for the last 6 minutes, until it flakes. Drain everything well.
Flake the cod into a bowl with the potatoes and mash roughly together. Stir in one egg, half the breadcrumbs, the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Form 8 cakes.
Coat the cakes in the beaten second egg and the rest of the breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the cakes about 4 minutes per side, until crisp and golden.
Serve with the garden salad, sour cream, and lemon wedges.
recipes.title: Cod Cakes with Garden Salad

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Toss the shrimp with half the chili powder, half the paprika, and the salt.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp about 2 minutes, until just pink. Set them aside.

Cook the pepper and onion in the same pan until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes with their juice, the cumin, garlic powder, and the rest of the chili powder and paprika. Simmer about 5 minutes.
Return the shrimp to the pan and cook 1 minute to warm through. Serve spooned over the rice.
recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp and Rice

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the lasagna noodles until just tender, drain, and lay them flat so they do not stick.
Cook the zucchini, mushrooms, and spinach in a dry pan about 5 minutes, until the spinach wilts and the pan juices cook off. Season with garlic powder and salt.
Stir the cream cheese, the egg, and half the parmesan together in a bowl.

Layer a third of the sauce in a 9 by 13 inch dish, then noodles, then half the vegetables and half the cheese mixture and a third of the mozzarella. Repeat, finishing with sauce and the rest of the mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake about 15 minutes more, until bubbling.
Rest 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrots, and potatoes until they start to soften, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, and chili powder and cook 1 minute.
Add the lentils, the tomatoes with their juice, and about 7 cups of water.
Simmer about 25 minutes, until the lentils and potatoes are tender, adding a little water if it gets thick.
Stir in the spinach and cook 2 minutes, until it wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls. The soup thickens as it sits, which makes the leftovers even better.
recipes.title: Lentil Vegetable Soup

steps: Stir the sour cream with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Toss half with the cabbage for a slaw and keep the rest for serving.

Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chickpeas with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt about 6 minutes, lightly mashing a few with the back of a spoon, until hot and a little crisp at the edges.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill the tortillas with chickpeas and slaw, top with tomato, and serve with the extra sauce and the tortilla chips.
recipes.title: Chickpea Tacos

steps: Mash the black beans in a bowl with a fork, leaving some beans whole.
Stir in the breadcrumbs, egg, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and salt. Form four patties and chill them for 10 minutes if there is time; it helps them hold together.
Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the patties about 4 minutes per side, until crisp outside and hot through. Lay the cheddar on top for the last minute.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with lettuce and tomato.
recipes.title: Black Bean Burgers

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Press the tofu cubes between paper towels for a few minutes to dry them, then toss them in the flour.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the tofu, turning now and then, about 8 minutes, until crisp and golden on most sides. Set it aside.
Add the broccoli and carrots to the pan with a splash of water, cover, and steam about 4 minutes, until tender-crisp.
Stir the soy sauce, honey, and garlic powder together, pour it over the vegetables, and return the tofu. Toss about 1 minute, until everything is glazed.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Crispy Tofu Stir Fry

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the lasagna noodles until just tender, drain, and lay them flat so they do not stick.
Stir the cream cheese, the egg, half the mozzarella, the parmesan, garlic powder, salt, and spinach together in a bowl.
Spread the filling along each noodle and roll it up.
Spread half the pasta sauce in a baking dish, set the rolls seam side down, and spoon the rest of the sauce over them. Top with the rest of the mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes. Uncover and bake about 8 minutes more, until bubbling.
recipes.title: Lasagna Roll-Ups with Spinach and Cheese

steps: Boil salted water and cook the egg noodles until tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large pan and cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook about 8 minutes, until they give up their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the flour, paprika, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute. Add about a cup of pasta water, stirring, and simmer until it thickens into a sauce.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the sour cream. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the mushrooms and sauce over the egg noodles.
recipes.title: Mushroom Stroganoff

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion until it softens, about 4 minutes.
Add the sweet potatoes, chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and stir for a minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, the black beans, and about a cup of water. Simmer about 20 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender and the chili has thickened.
Season with salt and serve with cheddar and sour cream on top.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chili

steps: Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Drain.
Stir the soy sauce, honey, and garlic powder together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat and cook the mushrooms until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cabbage, carrots, and mixed vegetables and cook about 4 minutes, until tender-crisp.
Add the spaghetti, pour in the sauce, and toss about 2 minutes, until everything is coated and hot.
recipes.title: Veggie Lo Mein

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Lay the tortillas on baking sheets and brush them lightly with the oil.
Salt the tomato slices and let them sit a few minutes, then pat them dry so the flatbreads stay crisp.
Top the tortillas with mozzarella, tomato slices, and pepperoni and sprinkle with garlic powder.
Bake about 8 minutes, until the cheese melts and the edges are crisp and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with the garden salad.
recipes.title: Tomato and Mozzarella Flatbreads

steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion and carrots until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute. Pour in the milk a little at a time, stirring.
Add the potatoes and simmer about 15 minutes, until they are tender, stirring now and then so the milk does not catch.
Stir in the corn and cook 3 minutes.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheddar until melted. Season with salt and pepper and serve.
recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Corn Chowder

steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion and carrots until soft, about 6 minutes. Stir in the flour and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the milk a little at a time, stirring, and bring it to a gentle simmer.
Add the broccoli and cook about 10 minutes, until tender. Mash or blend a little of the soup if you like it thicker, and stir it back in.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheddar and cream until the cheese melts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve in bowls.
recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup

steps: Cook the rice following the package directions and keep it warm.
Warm the black beans and corn together in a pan with the cumin, chili powder, salt, and a splash of water, about 5 minutes.
Spoon the rice into bowls and top with the beans and corn.
Add salsa, cheddar, sour cream, and lettuce at the table, with tortilla chips for scooping.
recipes.title: Rice and Bean Bowls with Salsa

ingredients.note: split between the crust and the filling

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Stir the flour with half the salt, cut in the butter, and stir in just enough cold water to hold a dough together. Press it into a pie dish or a 9 inch baking dish.
Whisk the eggs and milk with the rest of the salt and the pepper.
Scatter the broccoli and cheddar over the crust and pour the egg mixture over them.
Bake about 35 minutes, until the middle is just set and the top is golden.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Quiche

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and paprika, then the tomatoes with their juice. Simmer about 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens a little. Season with salt.
Make little wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook on low about 6 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.
Serve straight from the pan with the toasted bread for dipping.
recipes.title: Eggs in Spiced Tomato Sauce

steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the hash browns, pressing them down, about 10 minutes, until crisp and golden on the bottom.
Scatter the pepper and onion over the potatoes and cook about 5 minutes, stirring once, until they soften.
Season with the paprika, salt, and pepper and spread the hash flat.
Make wells and crack an egg into each, or pour beaten eggs evenly over the top. Cover and cook on low about 5 minutes, until the eggs are just set.
Scatter the cheddar over the top, cover for a minute to melt, and serve from the pan.
recipes.title: Breakfast Hash with Eggs and Cheese

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Stir the salsa with the chili powder, cumin, salt, and a splash of water in a wide bowl.
Mash the black beans roughly with a fork.
Dip each tortilla in the salsa to coat it, fill it with beans and the cheeses, and roll it up. Set the rolls seam side down in a baking dish.
Spoon the rest of the salsa over the rolls and scatter the remaining cheese on top.
Bake about 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Serve with sour cream.
recipes.title: Cheese and Black Bean Enchiladas
